speaker.role_note: The source page supplies the speaker label; no historical office is inferred beyond the printed wording during transcription.

source.relationship: For this speech, scan page = printed page + 1.

translation.voice_policy: Retain Kalaignar's parliamentary language and voice in English: argumentative sequence, repetition, direct address, humour, wordplay, irony, metaphors, register shifts and stage markers are preserved rather than polished into generic modern English; printed English and source claims/figures are not silently corrected.
translation.gate_g_batch_1_note: Gate G Batch 1 reviewed source pp.304-308 against the final verified Tamil. Two definite fidelity corrections were applied: p.304 restored the personal referent in `அவரை ... கேலியாகவோ, கிண்டலாகவோ, வசையாகவோ` instead of the impersonal 'all that'; p.307 corrected `ஈவுத் தொகை, Equity` from the inaccurate 'dividend component' to the amount provided through share investment — Equity. The stumble/music wordplay, temporary-weakness passage, போட்டாபோட்டி/காட்டாங்குஸ்தி sequence, வம்பு repetition, newspaper-headline tease, surrender joke, statistics, printed English and Sudarsanam humour were otherwise retained. English remains unverified until all 23 pages pass Gate G.
